条件概率 \(P\left(X>\frac12\mid Y=\frac13\right)\) 需要用到 \(X\mid Y=y\) 的条件密度：

\[
f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_Y(y)}
\]

先求边缘密度：

\[
f_Y(y)=\int_y^1 6y\,dx=6y(1-y),\quad 0<y<1
\]

当 \(y=\frac13\) 时，

\[
f_Y\left(\frac13\right)=6\cdot \frac13\cdot \frac23=\frac43
\]

因此

\[
f_{X\mid Y}\left(x\mid \frac13\right)
=\frac{6\cdot \frac13}{4/3}
=\frac32,\quad \frac13<x<1
\]

所以

\[
P\left(X>\frac12\mid Y=\frac13\right)
=\int_{1/2}^{1}\frac32\,dx
=\frac32\cdot\frac12
=\frac34
\]

答案：A
